╭ Keys ────────────────────────────────────────── esc to close ╮
│                                                              │
│  Review                         Everywhere                   │
│                                                              │
│  y       accept hunk            tab       next screen        │
│  n       drop hunk              ctrl+r    ask → review       │
│  A       accept all             ?         close              │
│  X       reject changeset       q/ctrl+c  quit               │
│  C       commit                                              │
│  p       preview / diff         Scroll                       │
│  j/k     down / up              pgup/pgdn page               │
│  g/G     top / bottom           ctrl+u/d  half page          │
│  s       split hunk · not built home/end  top / bottom       │
│                                                              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
